Established: Kentucky Revised Statutes (KRS 431.220) confirm that lethal injection is the default method of execution. The statute explicitly provides an exception for prisoners who received a death sentence prior to March 31, 1998, allowing them to choose between lethal injection and electrocution. If no choice is made at least 20 days before execution, lethal injection applies.
